revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Lin14-25 I might fuss over a couple of the udnerdots, but do not think it worth the trouble. This fuller accounting than the ed gives is in my view useful.

Vote - AcceptText - l1: => (Γεωργι(ο )) delete ll.15-19 and add commentary: The same text is repeated in 5 lines (Ἰουλίου being abbreviated as Ἰουλί(ου)), but not always in complete form, due to the damaged status of the papyrus. The text given is a reconstruction of the maximum legible text possible. delete ll. 21-25: and add a commentary: The same text is repeated in 5 lines, but not always in complete form, due to the damaged status of the papyrus. The text given is a reconstruction of the maximum legible text possible

Entered Greek text from P.Rain.Unterricht 55; lin14-19, 20-25-->added dots and brackets (edd give one general line of text without taking in account the irregular status of the papyrus in respective lines). Please check!!
